scripts.docker:deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@retail-ims/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=api && npm run test --workspace=web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=api --if-present && npm run lint --workspace=web --if-present
